title: LUMA: Personal AI Desktop Assistant
short_desc: My personal AI assistant for the desktop. Say "Luma" to wake it. Then you can chat, check the news and markets, use the camera, run commands or play music.
problem: I wanted one assistant for chat, news, music and commands that runs on my own computer instead of in the cloud.
built: LUMA has five tools on a bar at the bottom of the screen: a live news and markets feed, a chat window for voice or text, a camera view, a command terminal and a music player connected to Spotify.
result: A working desktop app that answers with a local model today. Version 1 is public on GitHub. The current version is private.
tech_notes: The frontend is a PyQt6 desktop app built around a central animated core and five modules on a bottom dock. World Feed shows a live TV stream, a market ticker and chart, a top story and headlines. Chat takes voice or text and uses draggable glass-style panels. Optic shows the live camera. Terminal runs Luma's own commands and skills. Music shows what is playing on Spotify and controls playback. Replies come from a local model through Ollama today. Later, I plan to swap in LUMA Brain, the small language model I am building from scratch. The source code is private.
